attributes.name: Alma Linux
attributes.label: alma-linux
attributes.description: Alma Linux is an open source, community-owned and governed, forever-free enterprise Linux distribution. It is focused on long-term stability, providing a robust production-grade platform. AlmaLinux OS is binary-compatible with RHEL. It is owned and controlled by the non-profit AlmaLinux OS Foundation, and managed by a community-elected board of directors and the self-managed AlmaLinux Engineering Steering Committee

attributes.name: CentOS
attributes.label: community-enterprise-operating-system
attributes.description: CentOS was a Linux distribution that provided a free, enterprise-class, community-supported computing platform functionally compatible with RHEL

attributes.name: Debian
attributes.label: debian
attributes.description: Debian is a free operating system for your computer. The Debian stable branch is the most popular edition for personal computers and network servers, and is used as the basis for many other Linux distributions

attributes.name: FreeBSD
attributes.label: freebsd
attributes.description: FreeBSD is an operating system used to power modern servers, desktops, and embedded platforms

attributes.name: Oracle Linux
attributes.label: oracle-linux
attributes.description: Oracle Linux is an Open Source, free RHEL derivative developed by Oracle to be a 100% application binary compatible alternative to Red Hat Enterprise Linux

attributes.name: Oracle Solaris
attributes.label: oracle-solaris
attributes.description: Oracle Solaris is a proprietary Unix operating system originally developed by Sun Microsystems. After the Sun acquisition by Oracle in 2010, it was renamed Oracle Solaris. It supports SPARC and x86-64 workstations and servers. It is known for its stability, performance, scalability and innovative features such as DTrace or ZFS

attributes.name: Red Hat Enterprise Linux
attributes.label: red-hat-enterprise-linux
attributes.description: Red Hat Enterprise Linux is a Linux distribution developed by Red Hat for the commercial market

attributes.name: Rocky Linux
attributes.label: rocky-linux
attributes.description: Rocky Linux is a Linux distribution intended to be a downstream, complete binary-compatible release using the Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating system source code. The project is led by Gregory Kurtzer, founder of the CentOS project

attributes.name: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
attributes.label: suse-linux-enterprise-server
attributes.description: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server is a modular linux distribution for both multimodal and traditional IT

attributes.name: Ubuntu
attributes.label: ubuntu
attributes.description: Ubuntu is a free and open-source Linux distribution based on Debian. Ubuntu is officially released in three editions: Desktop, Server, and Core

attributes.name: Windows
attributes.label: windows
attributes.description: Microsoft Windows is the operating system developed by Microsoft to run on workstations

attributes.name: Windows Server
attributes.label: windows-server
attributes.description: Microsoft Windows is the operating system developed by Microsoft to run on servers
